recognize_zh: 一顆大型異型細胞，深藍色細胞質內有細小空泡，細胞內可見已凝縮成條狀的染色體（有絲分裂中期樣）與旁邊另一團未分裂的核質，呈現核分裂不完全的異常分裂（endomitosis），圖中未能清楚辨認 Russell 小體。
features: Very large atypical cell with abundant deeply basophilic cytoplasm containing fine clear vacuoles
Condensed rod-like chromosomes in a metaphase-like arrangement occupying part of the cell
Separate eccentric nuclear mass with finely granular chromatin in the same cytoplasm (abnormal/incomplete division)
Plasma-cell-type basophilia; discrete Russell bodies not clearly identifiable in this image
Surrounding small lymphocytes, erythroid precursors and red cells
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a very large atypical cell with abundant, deeply basophilic, finely vacuolated cytoplasm. Within the cell there is a cluster of condensed, rod-like chromosomes in a metaphase-like configuration alongside a separate eccentric nuclear mass, indicating an abnormal mitosis with chromosome condensation not followed by normal nuclear division (endomitosis). The cytoplasmic basophilia supports plasmacytic differentiation, although discrete Russell bodies are not clearly seen in this field. In a patient with CLL, findings are consistent with a highly proliferative atypical plasmablastic cell, supporting Richter transformation to plasmablastic lymphoma.

ddx.vs: Megakaryocytes have granular pinkish cytoplasm and form a single lobulated polyploid nucleus rather than basophilic vacuolated plasmacytoid cytoplasm.

ddx.dx: Plasma cell myeloma with anaplastic/multinucleated cells
ddx.vs: Morphology may overlap; distinction relies on clinical features (M-protein, CRAB), CD20/PAX5 loss, EBER status and history of CLL.
Carcinoma cells tend to occur in cohesive clusters and are cytokeratin-positive, lacking CD138/MUM1 expression.
